query: Which controlled vocabularies and metadata schemas (CIDOC-CRM extensions, Darwin Core fields) ensure interoperability between European and Asian Pleistocene datasets?

response.query: Which controlled vocabularies and metadata schemas (CIDOC-CRM extensions, Darwin Core fields) ensure interoperability between European and Asian Pleistocene datasets?
response.answer: CIDOC-CRM extensions and the Dublin Core metadata schema ensure interoperability between European and Asian Pleistocene datasets. These schemas facilitate data mapping and integration across different cultural heritage and scientific domains.

Title: Mapping Cultural Metadata Schemas to CIDOC Conceptual Reference Model | Springer Nature Link
# Mapping Cultural Metadata Schemas to CIDOC Conceptual Reference Model. Managing heterogeneous data is a challenge for cultural heritage institutions as they host and develop various collections with heterogeneous types of material, described by different metadata schemas. In this paper, we propose an expressive mapping language for the mapping of XML-based metadata schemas to CIDOC CRM. We also show how these mappings can be used to transform metadata to CIDOC CRM data by considering the mapping of VRA Core 4.0 to CIDOC CRM.
